City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
SEPTEMBER 26, 2017
07:00
P.M.
9-26-17 Agenda
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Munoz, Lewis, Argudo, Holloway and Solis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of LEAD Students Attending the City Council Meeting
Check Presentation to the City by Assembly Member Ian Calderon, Majority Leader, 57th District
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF SEPTEMBER 12, 2017
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of September 12, 2017.
A-1 Minutes 9-12-17 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTIONS APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NOS. 1437 AND 52
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 17-5363 approving Warrant Register No. 1437 and Resolution No. SA 17-76 approving Warrant Register No. 52.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1437
D-1 Warrants Resolution SA #52
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONTRACT TO TUNNELWORKS SERVICES, INC., IN THE AMOUNT OF $222,738.40 FOR SANITARY SEWER MAINTENANCE SERVICES IN THE CITY
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) award the contract to Tunnelworks Services, Inc. in the amount of $222,738.40; and (2) authorize the City Manager to approve change orders up to 10% of the original bid amount.
D-2 Tunnelworks Award Sewer Cleaning Staff Report
D-2 Tunnelworks Award Sewer Cleaning Attachment A Agreement
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF AWARD OF CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT TO S&H CIVILWORKS FOR CONCRETE REPAIRS AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS CITYWIDE IN THE AMOUNT OF $271,500
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) award the contract to S&H Civilworks in the amount of $271,500; and (2) authorize the City Manager to approve change orders up to 10% of the original bid amount.
D-3 S&H Award Concrete Repairs Staff Report
D-3 S&H Award Concrete Repairs Attachment A Agreement
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A LICENSE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE AND JULIAN BLANDINO FOR THE USE OF CITY PROPERTY LOCATED AT THE INTERSECTION OF VALLEY BOULEVARD AND OLD VALLEY BOULEVARD
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the License Agreement between the City of La Puente and Julian Blandino; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-4 Blandino License Agreement Staff Report
D-4 Blandino License Agreement Attachment A Agreement
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION ESTABLISHING THE CITY COUNCILâ€™S 2018 REGULAR MEETING SCHEDULE
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-5364 establishing the 2018 City Council regular meeting schedule.
D-5 2018 Council Meeting Schedule Staff Report
D-5 2018 Council Meeting Schedule Attachment A Resolution
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF: (1) RESOLUTION NO. 17-5365, A RESOLUTION APPROVING THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE CITY AND SERVICE EMPLOYEES INTERNATIONAL UNION, LOCAL 721; AND (2) RESOLUTION NO. 17-5366, A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION NO. 17-5359, AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM AND ESTABLISHING THE NUMBER OF AUTHORIZED FULL-TIME POSITIONS AND MONTHLY RANGES FOR CITY EMPLOYEES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the revised job descriptions and salary ranges; (2) adopt Resolution No. 17-5365 approving the MOU with the SEIU for the period of July 1, 2017 through June 30, 2020; and (3) approve Resolution No. 17-5366 rescinding Resolution No. 17-5359 and amending the comprehensive personnel system and establishing the number of authorized full-time positions and monthly ranges for City employees.
D-6 MOU and Salary Resolution Staff Report
D-6 MOU and Salary Resolution Attachment A Job Descriptions
D-6 MOU and Salary Resolution Attachment B Ranges
D-6 MOU and Salary Resolution Attachment C MOU Resolution
D-6 MOU and Salary Resolution Attachment D Full-Time Resolution
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2017-2018 CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROGRAM BUDGET TO INCORPORATE PROJECTS FUNDED BY THE ROAD REPAIR AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2017 (SB 1)
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 17-5367 amending the Fiscal Year 2017-2018 Capital Improvement Program budget to incorporate projects funded by the Road Repair and Accountability Act of 2017 (SB 1).
D-7 SB 1 Projects Staff Report
D-7 SB 1 Projects Attachment A Resolution
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH THE CITY OF INDUSTRY FOR RECONSTRUCTION AND STREET IMPROVEMENTS TO VALLEY BOULEVARD
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the MOU; and (2) authorize the City Manager to negotiate and execute the MOU on behalf of the City.
E-1 MOU for Valley Blvd Improvements Staff Report
E-1 MOU for Valley Blvd Improvements Attachment A MOU

AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
